interface.shortDescription: Product management skills for AI agents
interface.longDescription: 68 product management skills across the full product lifecycle, including PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, OKRs, lean canvas, personas, meeting artifacts, discovery synthesis, measurement planning, release notes, workshop tools, workflow authoring and ad-hoc chaining, and pm-skills lifecycle utilities. v2.35.0 is a quality release: pm-skills now declares edition 0.17 of the Advanced Skill Library Standard at Bronze in a new library.json, measure-instrumentation-spec 3.0.1 and utility-pm-release-conductor 1.0.2 bring two templates back in line with their own skills, and the sample library gains a Model Trace Capture example. No new skills; catalog stays 68 skills / 6 sub-agents. Full release history: https://github.com/product-on-purpose/pm-skills/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
